title: Define nomination & voting policy framework

commonRules: target must be eligible under the exact season/category EligibilityPolicy snapshot
target must remain PUBLIC and canonically available at nomination acceptance and ballot freeze
withdrawn, deleted, unavailable, rights-blocked or otherwise ineligible targets fail closed
eligibility is evaluated from canonical Creative/publication/disclosure sources and frozen references rather than mutable application labels
recordingRules: RECORDING target requires a canonical published RecordingId
Recording publication must fall inside the category eligibility window when that category requires a release-window predicate
source Work/Recording/disclosure/provenance state remains externally authoritative
creatorRules: CREATOR_PROFILE target requires a canonical CreatorId

artist-category eligibility requires at least one eligible published Recording in the season/category eligibility window unless the exact category policy explicitly defines another canonical predicate
Creator profile presentation does not substitute for published-recording eligibility

categoryPolicyRequirements: every active AwardCategory must bind exactly one EligibilityPolicy version/commitment

every category policy must explicitly declare targetType, eligibility window, nomination mode, max nominations per nominator, self-nomination mode, voter eligibility mode, quorum mode/value, winner mode/value and tie mode before nominations open
category policy changes after NOMINATIONS_OPEN require a replacement season/category/policy rather than silent mutation
other initial categories do not automatically exclude HUMAN or AI classes solely because of disclosure class
nominationRules: nomination window is [nominationStart, nominationEnd] inclusive under the frozen season clock semantics
nomination outside the open window fails closed
nominator must have qualified Wallet/session actor authorization
self-nomination behavior is controlled only by the frozen category selfNomination mode
maxNominationsPerNominator is a positive explicit category policy value and cannot be silently treated as unlimited
duplicate logical nomination key is seasonId + categoryId + targetType + targetId + nominatorEligibilityKey; replay is idempotent or rejected without a second count
the ballot candidate key is seasonId + categoryId + targetType + targetId so multiple eligible nominators never create duplicate ballot candidates
a nomination that later becomes ineligible may be DISQUALIFIED before ballot freeze with a durable reason commitment
after BALLOT_FROZEN, ordinary nomination acceptance/rejection cannot mutate that ballot
communityThresholdRules: COMMUNITY_THRESHOLD nomination mode requires an explicit thresholdType and thresholdValue in the frozen category policy
eligible support is derived only from policy-approved PUBLIC community records; PRIVATE/UNLISTED community state is excluded
duplicate/replayed community relations cannot multiply threshold support
COMMUNITY_CHOICE does not imply any fixed threshold number in HZ-GCA-1.13; the exact season/category policy must declare it
community threshold satisfaction may make a target nomination-eligible but never casts AwardVote records
ballotConstructionRules: ballot construction begins only after nominations close
candidate set is the deterministic deduplicated set of ACCEPTED still-eligible nominations for the exact category
candidateSetCommitment and policyCommitment are frozen before AwardBallot enters FROZEN
candidate ordering for presentation is deterministic and cannot change target identity
after FROZEN, candidate membership is immutable; correction requires VOID plus explicit replacement ballot under the same frozen season policy or a replacement season if policy itself changed
voting cannot open unless the ballot, voter-eligibility mode, quorum, winner and tie policy are fully specified
voterEligibilityRules: Wallet/session authorization proves the actor controls the voting account but does not prove unique-human identity
WALLET_ONE_ACCOUNT_ONE_VOTE means one qualified Wallet/account key per ballot and must never be described as one-person-one-vote
IDENTITY_UNIQUE_ONE_VOTE requires a qualified minimum-disclosure eligibility result from the canonical Identity authority or approved verifier source
identity eligibility proof must be domain-separated to Awards ballot/policy/audience and reveal no unnecessary raw legal identity, document, biometric, wallet-link or credential payload
revoked, expired, stale, wrong-ballot, wrong-policy or wrong-audience Identity eligibility fails closed
JURY_ONE_MEMBER_ONE_VOTE requires a frozen explicit jury membership snapshot/reference and one eligible jury member key per ballot
production public voting that claims unique-human semantics must use IDENTITY_UNIQUE_ONE_VOTE or a later equally explicit qualified policy; Wallet addresses alone are insufficient
antiSybilRules: vote policy must explicitly declare its Sybil assumptions and cannot imply stronger uniqueness than its eligibility mode proves
WALLET_ONE_ACCOUNT_ONE_VOTE receives replay protection but is acknowledged as wallet-account uniqueness only
IDENTITY_UNIQUE_ONE_VOTE consumes only the minimum-disclosure uniqueness/eligibility conclusion and a ballot-scoped nullifier or equivalent replay key; raw identity evidence remains outside Awards
a ballot-scoped voter key/nullifier contributes at most one accepted vote
multiple wallets resolving to the same qualified unique-human proof/nullifier cannot create multiple votes
rate limits, anomaly flags or moderation may pause/review suspicious submissions but cannot fabricate a voter credential or silently rewrite valid votes
Sybil controls cannot expose private Identity proof material in public AwardVote or result records
voteRules: vote window is [votingStart, votingEnd] inclusive under frozen season clock semantics
vote before opening or after closing fails closed
every vote binds ballotId, voterEligibilityRef/key, choiceCommitment, submittedAt and a domain-separated replayDomain
one voter eligibility key may have at most one ACCEPTED vote per ballot
duplicate vote/replay is rejected or idempotently resolves to the existing accepted vote and never increments totals
choice must reference an exact frozen candidate or explicit ABSTAIN when abstention is enabled by policy
vote mutation after acceptance is forbidden in v1; change-your-vote requires a future explicit policy version
invalidated vote status requires a durable objective reason/evidence reference and cannot be used as an operator edit to favor a candidate
abstentionInvalidRules: ABSTAIN is explicit and optional per category policy
an accepted abstention counts toward participation quorum when the quorum mode measures participation, but contributes zero candidate support
INVALIDATED votes count neither toward quorum nor candidate support after canonical invalidation
malformed, ineligible, duplicate, stale-policy or wrong-ballot votes are rejected before acceptance where determinable
final tally records accepted candidate votes, accepted abstentions and invalidated/rejected counts separately
quorumThresholdRules: every category policy must choose exactly one quorum mode and explicit positive threshold value before voting opens
MIN_VALID_VOTES quorum counts accepted candidate votes plus accepted abstentions only when abstention participation is enabled by the policy
MIN_PARTICIPATION_BPS quorum is evaluated against the frozen eligible-voter denominator/reference and fails closed if that denominator cannot be established
PLURALITY winner mode selects the highest candidate valid-vote total after quorum
MIN_SHARE_BPS additionally requires each winner to satisfy the frozen minimum candidate-share threshold
threshold arithmetic uses exact integer-safe comparisons defined by the implementation policy and cannot be changed after voting opens
tieRules: tie policy is explicit per category before voting opens
CO_WINNERS returns all candidates tied at the winning score/threshold
NO_WINNER produces a finalized no-winner outcome and no AwardBadge for that category
RUNOFF_REQUIRED produces no winner from the tied ballot and requires a deterministic replacement/runoff ballot limited to the tied candidates under the frozen runoff policy
target identifier ordering may normalize output display but cannot silently resolve a substantive winner tie unless a future policy explicitly defines that as the tie rule
random tie-breaking is not part of v1 and cannot be invented at runtime
deterministicFinalizationRules: finalization may begin only after votingEnd and only from a valid CLOSED ballot
finalizer recomputes eligibility mode, accepted vote set, quorum, threshold, tie handling and winner set from the frozen policy and canonical accepted vote records
same ballot/policy/accepted-vote set produces the same resultCommitment and winnerTargetIds/no-winner disposition
finalization is single-use for the exact ballot; repeated finalization returns the existing result or fails without creating another AwardResult
result records policyCommitment, tally commitment, winner/no-winner disposition, finalizedAt and exact ballot reference
a finalized season/result cannot be retroactively re-tallied under a new policy; correction/dispute must use explicit superseding history under HZ-GCA-1.14
privacyRules: public tally/result may reveal aggregate counts permitted by policy but not wallet signatures, private keys, raw Identity proofs, legal identity or hidden voter-linkage data
AwardVote visibility follows the privacy policy and need not reveal voter identity publicly
ballot-scoped nullifiers/eligibility references must not be reusable across unrelated ballots to correlate voters unnecessarily
private/secret Identity evidence remains outside Search/Indexer/Analytics public projection
minimum-disclosure proof results are consumed only for the exact eligibility predicate needed by the ballot
failureRules: nomination outside the frozen window fails closed
unpublished or canonically unavailable Recording nomination fails closed
duplicate nomination replay cannot create duplicate ballot candidates
community threshold using PRIVATE/UNLISTED support is invalid
voting opens without frozen candidate set/policy/quorum/winner/tie semantics fails closed
Wallet-only voter mode claiming one-person-one-vote is invalid
IDENTITY_UNIQUE_ONE_VOTE without qualified current minimum-disclosure eligibility fails closed
duplicate/replayed voter key cannot create a second accepted vote
vote for non-candidate or wrong ballot fails closed
quorum denominator unavailable for MIN_PARTICIPATION_BPS fails closed
finalization before votingEnd or from non-CLOSED ballot fails closed
repeated finalization cannot create a second AwardResult
closed/finalized season cannot be recomputed under a later policy
invariants: HZGCA-VOTE-001 nomination and voting policy is frozen per season/category before participation and is never silently reinterpreted
HZGCA-VOTE-002 eligible song-category targets reference canonical published Recordings; artist-category eligibility retains canonical Creator plus required published-work predicate
HZGCA-VOTE-003 AI-generated, AI-assisted and AI-derivative categories enforce exact disclosure compatibility
HZGCA-VOTE-004 nomination replay/caps/self-nomination rules are explicit and cannot create duplicate ballot candidates
HZGCA-VOTE-005 community-threshold support consumes only eligible PUBLIC deduped community state and never becomes an Award vote
HZGCA-VOTE-006 ballot candidate set and voting policy are immutable after FROZEN
HZGCA-VOTE-007 Wallet authorization proves account control only and never unique-human identity
HZGCA-VOTE-008 any unique-human voting claim requires qualified minimum-disclosure Identity eligibility and fails closed when unavailable/stale/revoked
HZGCA-VOTE-009 one ballot-scoped voter key/nullifier creates at most one accepted vote per ballot
HZGCA-VOTE-010 raw Identity evidence, legal identity, wallet signing secrets and private proof payloads never enter AwardVote/public tally state
HZGCA-VOTE-011 abstention, invalid/rejected votes and candidate votes remain separately accounted
HZGCA-VOTE-012 quorum, winner threshold and tie semantics are explicit frozen policy inputs
HZGCA-VOTE-013 ties are handled only by the declared CO_WINNERS, NO_WINNER or RUNOFF_REQUIRED policy; no hidden/random tie break exists
HZGCA-VOTE-014 identical frozen ballot/policy/accepted-vote inputs produce deterministic finalization
HZGCA-VOTE-015 repeated finalization cannot create multiple results for one ballot
HZGCA-VOTE-016 finalized/closed season history is not retroactively recomputed under later policy
HZGCA-VOTE-017 Chart rank, Community popularity, payment/prize state and Civic governance cannot substitute for nomination/voting authority
HZGCA-VOTE-018 nomination/voting policy creates no new Creative rights, Identity trust, payment, governance or Chart authority
exitCriteria: eligibility windows and canonical published-target requirements are explicit
nomination caps, duplicate prevention, self-nomination and optional community thresholds are explicit
Wallet, Identity and jury voter-eligibility modes are explicit with honest Sybil guarantees
privacy-preserving unique-human proof consumption and fail-closed unavailability are explicit
vote replay, abstention, invalid-vote, quorum, winner-threshold and tie policies are explicit
deterministic close/finalization and no-retroactive-recompute rules are explicit
targeted verifier enforces the frozen policy vocabulary and invariants
no Identity proof scheme, ABI, runtime service, deployment or testnet state is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.14 through HZ-GCA-1.20
